verdict.rationale: Polar documents a dedicated, fully isolated sandbox environment (separate server, unlimited test accounts/orgs) supporting end-to-end test payments via Stripe test cards, and even exposes a distinct sandbox MCP endpoint (polar-sandbox) separate from production, letting AI-native users and agents test without touching production data. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on third-party account of using the sandbox in practice beyond vendor docs and probes.
